label.en: Mysterious and alluring: cello ostinato, harp like glinting coins
label.ru: Загадочно и манит: остинато виолончели, арфа как блеск монет
label.pl: Tajemniczo i kusząco: ostinato wiolonczeli, harfa jak błysk monet

gleam-1.prompt: The title screen: a treasure chest of gold gleams in a dark dungeon while monsters stand guard. Mysterious and alluring: low cello and viola ostinato, harp arpeggios like glinting coins, a haunting wooden flute melody. D minor, around 80 bpm. About two and a half minutes at one level.

label.en: Grim heroic call: horns and strings in minor, war drums
label.ru: Мрачный героический зов: валторны и струнные в миноре, боевые барабаны
label.pl: Ponure bohaterskie wezwanie: rogi i smyczki w molu, bębny

call-1.prompt: A dark heroic call to adventure before entering a dungeon full of monsters: low horns and strings carry a proud theme in a minor key over steady war drums, a lute answers. Brave and grim, not bright. E minor, around 90 bpm. About two and a half minutes at one level.

label.en: Eerie and a little playful: celesta over a cello drone
label.ru: Жутковато и чуть игриво: челеста над гулом виолончели
label.pl: Upiornie i trochę figlarnie: czelesta nad wiolonczelą

eerie-1.prompt: An eerie, slightly playful dungeon theme: a celesta and glockenspiel treasure motif over a low cello drone and soft pizzicato, ghostly and curious, like skeletons and a ghost guarding gold. C minor, around 76 bpm. About two and a half minutes at one level.

label.en: A slow dark march into the depths

march-1.prompt: A slow dark fantasy march into the depths: soft taiko and frame drums, low brass chords, a lute and a viola trading a solemn melody, torches flickering. Steady, weighty, adventurous in a dark way. D minor, around 84 bpm. About two and a half minutes at one level.
